notes.title: Update 3.5.11.0
notes.content:
[b]Please note, that Windows 10 or 11 is now mandatory! Windows ARM is also supported.[/b]

This update only includes minor fixes.

Did you know, ZUSI 3 now features [b]2200km of routes[/b] and more than [b]300 vehicles in over 1600 variants[/b]?

Have fun driving!
